flags.summary: The party met Ilinca Vrana, the Keeper of the Feather who watches the mill from the dead oak (ilinca; children sets it if she first appears at the end).
Ilinca flies into the mill with the party as a guest (join ilinca_vrana); she leaves with the children.
The party had struck the Keepers' raven on the Svalich road and failed to talk Ilinca round; she won't fly with them.
Ilinca vouched for the party to the Keepers of the Feather after the children were freed. Vallaki (Urwin) and the Wizard of Wines (the Martikovs) may read it; the lane's ravens leave a gift.
Ilinca explained that three hags together are a coven and how to split them (Offalia's appetite, Bella's grudge).
The party found Brother Kesten's holy symbol in the bone heap behind the mill.
The party read Morgantha's receipt book in the bakery (the special flour, the ledger of who owes).
The party opened Morgantha's pastry cart in the shed; she notices.
The party met Offalia Wormwiggle at the oven.
Offalia ate one of her mother's dream pastries and fell asleep on the bakery floor; she sits out the last stand.
The party tricked Offalia into running down the hill to find her mother; she sits out the last stand. Sending her home from the lane clears it.
Offalia is loose in the valley (lured away, or left asleep after Morgantha fell); she may be met on the lane.
Offalia is dead: the bakery fight, the last stand (set as it begins), killed asleep, or the lane.
The party met Bella Sunbane (on the stair after Offalia, or at her mirror in the loft).
The party promised Bella the mill if she stayed out of the fight; she sits out the last stand and claims the mill and the soul bags after.
The party tricked Bella into believing the mill would go to Offalia; she left the coven in a fury and is loose in the valley.
Bella is dead: the last stand (set as it begins), broken faith in the loft, or the lane.
The party cut the coven's soul bags open and freed the souls inside (also returns a dream taken in Morgantha's bargain).
The party kept faith with Bella and let her take the soul bags with the mill.
The party spoke with Morgantha in the loft of her mill.
Set as the last stand begins: Offalia comes up the stair to fight beside her mother (picks the coven_last_stand variant).
Set as the last stand begins: Bella fights beside her mother (picks the coven_last_stand variant).
Morgantha is dead and the coven broken (coven_last_stand won). Later regions: no more pastry cart with her at it; the village and Vallaki may hear.

How the party bought the children back without a fight: gold (150 gp), dream (one party member's sweetest dream; she visits their sleep), truce (their word to leave the mill alone), or abandoned (they left the children). Later regions may read it.
The party spoke with Ilka and Toma Sarnov in their cages.
Ilka and Toma Sarnov are out of the cages and safe (the region's milestone). The village and Vallaki may read it: the children came home, or came to the Blue Water Inn.
The party told Ilka that her mother sold them, rather than lying to her.
Where the Sarnov children went: home (to their mother in the Village of Barovia) or vallaki (to Urwin Martikov at the Blue Water Inn). For the village and Vallaki to read.

THE END STATE of Old Bonegrinder: destroyed (all three hags dead), broken (Morgantha dead, a daughter loose), bella (Bella holds the mill by the party's pact), bargain (the coven stands; the children were bought back), abandoned (the party left the children). Later regions and the epilogue read it.

What became of the dream-pastry trade: ended (no hags left), dwindling (one daughter sells a few, badly), thriving (the coven goes on). Unset means unchanged. Village of Barovia and Vallaki pastry sellers should read it.
The party burned the mill down after the children were out.
The party knocked the brake out of the great gear; the sails turn again.
The party met Morgantha with her cart on the miller's lane (road event).
